title: manni terminology strict (1.0.0-proposal.1)
description: The strict overlay for manni:terminology:1.0.0-proposal.1. Stack it beside the open draft. It narrows the form of values the draft already claims and requires no key. An entry either defines its term or redirects with `see`, so strict rejects a page that carries both. The open draft leaves that case to `manni term check`.

label.description: Strict holds the preferred label to one line with no surrounding space.

see.description: Strict holds the redirect target to one line with no surrounding space, the form a label takes.
